hooks.command: node -e "const c=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT;if(c&&c.includes('git commit')){const r=require('child_process');const s=r.execSync('git status --porcelain',{encoding:'utf8'});const staged=r.execSync('git diff --cached --name-only',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);const docs=['requirements.md','architecture.md','design-review.md','impl-plan.md','code-review.md','verification-report.md'];const hasSrc=staged.some(f=>!docs.includes(f)&&!f.startsWith('tests/'));const missingDocs=docs.filter(d=>hasSrc&&!require('fs').existsSync(d));if(missingDocs.length>0)console.warn('WARNING: Committing source code but these SDLC docs are missing: '+missingDocs.join(', '));}" 2>/dev/null || true
